lot_geometry.coordinate_system: Local survey bearing system. NW corner (Point A) is origin. All bearings are compass bearings (clockwise from North).

A.name: NW rear-left
A.description: Origin point. Rear property line meets left boundary.

B.name: NE rear-right
B.description: Rear property line meets right boundary.

C.name: SE front-right
C.description: Right boundary meets Blairmont Court cul-de-sac.

D.name: SW front-left
D.description: Left boundary meets Blairmont Court cul-de-sac arcs.

rear.description: Rear property line. Shared with Lot 14.

right_side.notes: 16-foot Drainage & Utility Easement along rear portion.

front.description: Curved cul-de-sac frontage on Blairmont Court. Consists of two arcs plus a straight tangent segment.

C1.direction: CW (sweep=1 in SVG going forward D→C1end)

C2.direction: CCW (sweep=0 in SVG going forward C1end→C2end)
C2.notes: Reverse curve from C1 — opposite sweep direction, creating S-shape.

tangent.description: Straight tangent segment connecting C2 arc end to SE lot corner. This is the '57.59' N47°30'E' label on the survey.

area.discrepancy_note: 3% difference from GIS tax parcel — within normal tolerance.

house.builder: Boone Homes (likely — same builder as similar homes on street)

yard_depths.note: Backyard is shallow (~23ft) — largely occupied by garage rear wall and brick patio. House has rear-loading garage.

power_box.description: Power Box (filled square on survey). On left boundary, approx 126ft from NW corner (A) along left boundary bearing.
power_box.anchor_instructions: This is the recommended GPS anchor point. It is a physical utility box visible above ground on the left/west property boundary, approximately 126ft from the rear-left corner going south.

tv_pedestal.description: TV Pedestal (triangle). Near front-right corner of lot.

stone_point.description: Stone Point (diamond). Near front-left area of lot.

svg_coordinate_system.origin: SVG canvas top-left. NW corner (A) placed at approx (50,50) after margin offset.
svg_coordinate_system.y_axis: Positive Y goes SOUTH (downward on screen) — standard SVG convention.

computing_corners.note: All corners computed from bearing vectors. Bearing to SVG vector: r = (90 - bearing_degrees) * PI/180; x = cos(r); y = -sin(r)

irrigation.ha_entity_pattern: switch.rachio_zone_N (verify exact IDs in HA Developer Tools)

ha_entities.note: Verify exact entity IDs in HA Developer Tools → States
